description: Helper functions for converting between ADODB recordset objects and XMLRPC values, including functions to build XMLRPC structs from recordsets and vice versa, with external dependencies on xmlrpc.inc and adodb.inc.php.

methods.name: rs2xmlrpcval
methods.description: Converts an ADODB recordset to an XMLRPC struct value.

methods.name: rs2xmlrpcval_header
methods.description: Creates an XMLRPC header struct describing the recordset.

methods.name: rs2xmlrpcval_body
methods.description: Creates an XMLRPC body struct with recordset data.

methods.name: rs2xmlrpcstring
methods.description: Serializes an ADODB recordset to an XMLRPC string.

methods.name: xmlrpcval2rs
methods.description: Converts an XMLRPC struct back into an ADODB recordset object.
